messages:
jess: Heads-up — long-running generator jobs show steady VRAM growth on paged KV in PagedAttention mode. A100 runs look stable; MI250 experiments show ~1.2GB drift over 30m. attaching short traces and telemetry.

jess: perf snippet:
```
KVPager: scan_loop +0.12s
evict_scan_calls=1284 evicted_pages=0 reuse_hits=6
page_table_slots=49152 hole_count=237
async_evict_backlog=42
```

omar: do we have the pagewalk counters and kernel selection for the MI runs? sounds like slow eviction or reuse window not firing.

jess: telemetry for the failing job (mi250-4): `pt_walks_total=1.9e6`, `pt_walk_failures=12`, `last_compact_ts=6887651200`, `reuse_window_ms=50` — eviction never actually frees pages.

liam: That pattern (evicted_pages=0 with high scan calls) smells like PT entries getting pinned by stale owner stamps. We saw a similar symptom when the tiled kernel used 64B page strides vs 256B on A100. Kernel selection may be misaligned on MI.

natalie: Can we repro with a minimal longctx runner? try `--batch 1 --ctx 8k --longctx 16k` and set `KVCACHE_MAX_SLOTS=8192` to force earlier eviction.

jess: repro command I used: `./bench/longctx_runner --model paged-attn --gpu mi250 --batch-size 1 --ctx 64 --longctx 16384`

infra-bot: job 4523 started on mi250-4 (ami:rtx-kernel-v2)

omar: pulled logs from 4523 — seeing repeated DMA stall at 12:03:21 and then `kv_pager: async_evict_queue_length=40` growth. snippet:
```
[12:03:18] DMA: submitted 64 pages
[12:03:21] DMA: stalled waiting for ack (pci:0x3)
[12:03:21] kv_pager: mark_owner(0x7f) stamp++
[12:03:21] pagewalk: retry due to owner stamp mismatch
```

liam: Two immediate experiments: 1) force the MI kernel selection to `kv_pager_coalesce_v2` (it has different stride/coalesce logic) and 2) bump `page_table_compact_interval` to force compaction sooner. Also compare the compiled kernel flags (ROCM vs CUDA) — autotuner commit `0f3a2` recently changed the fallback path.

jess: testing `coalesce_v2` now. Preliminary run for 45m shows leak dropped to ~50MB/30m (instead of 1.2GB/30m). will run overnight and collect PT diffs.

natalie: Created a small canary in runtime: if `reuse_hits < 10 && evicted_pages == 0` for >5m then fallback to `direct-evict` path. That should avoid long growth while we debug.

omar: FYI this correlates with the autotune change 0f3a2 -> it switched which kernel is selected for MI under small-batch longctx. Suggest we roll that change back or gate it behind a flag until we confirm correctness. :eyes:

jess: opened issue infra/kv/541 and tagged eng-runtime. adding kernel selection logs and PT snapshots. PR with rollback candidate incoming.

liam: nice. once we have PT snapshot diff and kernel blobs, we can repro offline and add a unit test around owner-stamp semantics.

jess: thanks — will post results in the issue and drop the full perf tarball there. https://redwood-internal/infra/kv/541
